summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything:** I read the full watchlist path (schema, handlers, route registration), the auth middleware and session code, and the client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `api.ts`). On static review, the wiring is actually correct end-to-end: - `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` are scoped by `user_id`/`watchlist_id`, every handler checks ownership. - The watchlist router has its own `X-User-Id`-injecting auth middleware (mirrors the portfolio pattern, just declared locally instead of in `server.ts` — harmless, not a bug
